jobs.title: Accounting Manager (Interim)
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Founded in 2010, Semios Group is a leading agricultural technology company helping growers, agronomists, and ag retailers manage over 200 million acres across five countries. Semios pioneered variable-rate pheromone-based mating disruption in orchards and has since expanded into a comprehensive portfolio covering crop protection, water management, frost control, automation, and a leading farm management information system. The Semios Group includes trusted brands such as Semios, Agworld, Altrac, and Greenbook. We continue to drive the next generation of digital agriculture, supporting growers, agronomists and ag retailers in improving sustainability and profitability.

Our innovative work has been recognized with several industry awards, including:

  • AgTech Breakthrough – Smart Irrigation Company & Pest Management Solution of the Year
  • Thrive Top 50
  • Google for Startups Accelerator Cohort
  • Global Cleantech Top 100

We know our journey is only achievable by having a great team who shares ideas, tries new things, and learns as we go.

Who you are:

The Accounting Manager is responsible for overseeing the month end processing and consolidating reporting of the organization. 

You’re driven by purpose and motivated by work that matters. You’re looking for more than a role, you want to be part of a growing, forward-thinking company solving real-world challenges to improve how farming works, today and for the future. 

What you will do:

  • Financial Reporting: Review the trial balance and supporting financial information to assess completeness, accuracy, and reasonableness. Support Financial Controller in preparation and review of financial statements, management reports and supporting analysis to ensure accurate and timely reporting. 
  • Monthly Close Process: Coordinate and support the monthly and year-end close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and efficient completion. Prepare and review journals,  reconciliations, analytics, schedules, and working papers supporting financial results. Monitor close deliverables, identify bottlenecks, and work with cross-functional Finance teams to resolve issues and maintain reporting timelines.
  • Financial Analysis: Preparation and review of month-end and year-end working papers, including Balance Sheet reconciliation reconciliation reports and functional/departmental analysis reports.
  • Statutory & Regulatory Compliance: Coordinate the year-end audit effort, including close collaboration with external auditors, and assist with the production of year end statutory accounts. Review and maintain Transfer Pricing policies.
  • Accounting Team Support & Knowledge Sharing: Provide technical guidance, coaching, and support to accounting team members, including assistance with complex reconciliations, accounting issues, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Identify accounting issues and improvements as they occur and recommend solutions including automation and integration of business tools and documentation of policies and procedures.

Requirements

We want you to succeed, so you will need:

  • 3+  years of full cycle accounting experience with companies with multiple subsidiaries in different jurisdictions
  • Experience leading and managing the month end process and preparing financial reports
  • A resilient, flexible, solution oriented approach to addressing areas of improvement, likes digging into issues and enjoys taking leadership in addressing problems
  • Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Self-directed, highly motivated and energetic
  • Outstanding work ethic with strong commitment to quality and delivering on time
  • Comfortable as an individual contributor, collaborative team member and leader
  • Qualified CPA


Nice to have: 

  • Public practice experience
  • Similar experience in technology, SaaS, hardware, manufacturing, or agriculture-related industries.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics
  • Experience improvement productivity through automation and tool implementation
  • Experience of identifying and implementing improvements that drive efficiencies and business performance
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Suite

Salary range: $115,000 to $123,000 per year

We publish a salary range to provide transparency and represent the full growth potential of the role; as a result, offers are made based on demonstrated mastery and experience and generally fall near the midpoint.

This is a temporary, full-time role covering a leave of absence through November 2027.

Benefits

Why this is the opportunity for you:

  • Purposeful Work: Make a global impact by advancing sustainable food production.
  • Our People: Work with a fun, collaborative, and supportive team.
  • Recharge: Generous vacation policy, company-paid holidays and year-end winter break.
  • Work Flexibility: Hybrid working arrangements and strong work-life balance culture.
  • Prioritize Your Well-Being: Access comprehensive health plans designed to support your physical and mental health.
  • Group RRSP, which includes a 3% company paid match after three months of employment
  • Office location that is convenient via transit and bike paths

At Semios Group, we value the full range of experience and perspectives people bring—not just what’s listed in a job description. If your background is a close match, we encourage you to apply. If you need accommodations during the interview process, please let us know. 

We welcome all applicants regardless of race, gender, orientation, sexual identity, economic class, ability, disability, age, religious beliefs or disbeliefs, or status. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish.

  • Thrive Top 50
  • Google for Startups Accelerator Cohort
  • Global Cleantech Top 100

We know our journey is only achievable by having a great team who shares ideas, tries new things, and learns as we go.

Who you are:

We are seeking a data-driven Corporate Development & Market Strategy Lead to accelerate our growth leveraging applied technology in agricultural-based supply chains. This veteran contributor role bridges the gap between high-stakes business expansion and strategic market intelligence. You will evaluate corporate growth opportunities—including mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and strategic commercial relationships—while leading and evaluating deep market research.

You’re driven by purpose and motivated by work that matters. You’re looking for more than a role, you want to be part of a growing, forward-thinking company solving real-world challenges to improve how farming works, today and for the future. 

What you will do:

  • Commercial Relationships: Collaborate with go-to-market leads to structure, negotiate, and frame high-impact commercial relationships, joint ventures, and channel partnerships across the agricultural ecosystem.
  • Transaction Support: Build comprehensive business cases, construct financial valuation models, and coordinate cross-functional due diligence efforts with product, legal, and finance teams.
  • Strategic Growth Execution: Manage the corporate development pipeline from initial sourcing and deal structuring through to integration planning and partnership with Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • M&A Evaluation: Identify, research, and screen prospective acquisition targets that align with our product portfolio and long-term corporate roadmap.
  • Market Sizing Assessments: Conduct rigorous Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM), and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM) analyses to evaluate new geographies and crop segments.
  • Strategic Insights: Synthesize ag production, market and commercial data; grower trends; and competitive intelligence into qualified assessments that help steer market expansion, new product development and sales strategy.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) Alignment: Translate market research into actionable briefs for the marketing and sales teams, defining buyer personas with product management, regional challenges, and collaboration with the commercial enablement team on optimal pricing frameworks.
  • Trend Tracking: Monitor macroeconomic agricultural trends, regulatory changes (e.g., carbon credits, biological approvals), and emerging technology shifts to safeguard our market position.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agribusiness, Agronomy, Business, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.
  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in corporate development, strategic marketing, management consulting, or venture capital, preferably within the applied technology, AgTech, SaaS, or precision agriculture sectors.
  • Proven track record of independently building market models, assessing market share data, and evaluating corporate transaction structures.

Skills

  • AgTech Domain Knowledge: Understanding of the agricultural value chain from hands-on experience, including work with growers, retail distributors, equipment OEMs, and agronomic workflows.
  • Financial & Analytical Modeling: Strong proficiency in financial valuation, market-sizing math to self-sufficiently translate complex datasets into clear executive presentations.
  • Strategic Assessment: Ability to look beyond basic metrics to make highly qualified recommendations on whether to buy, build, or partner.
  • Cross-Functional Productivity: Exceptional verbal and written skills, with a proven ability to align commercial and operational objectives and plans, sales directors, and executive leadership.

Nice to have: 

  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s in Finance/Agribusiness) or CFA designation.
  • Direct experience in deal execution, M&A integration, or strategic alliance negotiation within AgTech, SaaS, or IoT space.
  • Deep network within the agricultural technology ecosystem, including retail distributors, OEMs, and agronomic service providers.
  • Familiarity with carbon markets, biological registration frameworks, and environmental sustainability incentives.

Salary range: $108,000 to $164,000 USD per year

We publish a salary range to provide transparency and represent the full growth potential of the role; as a result, offers are made based on demonstrated mastery and experience and generally fall near the midpoint.

  • Work Flexibility: Enjoy a hybrid office setting or fully remote. (role dependent)

jobs.title: Customer Success Representative

With Agworld they cut out unnecessary emails, phone calls and text messages, and instead can rely on having access to up-to-date information on their iPhone, iPad or computer at all times.

Part of Semios Group

  • Ensure your training is maintained and continue to develop relevant knowledge, techniques and skills.

  • Ensure all day-to-day activities are recorded, managed and completed effectively to ensure a high level of productivity.

Inbound and Technical Support

  • First-line inbound support, providing excellent customer service and care: phone, in-app chat, and email.
  • Support new client onboarding by assisting with technical setup, such as importing data, configuring accounts, and connecting clients.
  • Provide ad-hoc training as part of the inbound support.

  • Strong listening, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and organisational abilities.

  • A proactive mindset with a focus on initiative and continuous improvement.

Skills

  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Experience using customer support platforms, CRM systems, and SaaS tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple customer interactions while maintaining a high level of service quality.

Renewals and Customer Engagement

Our innovative work has been recognized with several industry awards, including:

  • AgTech Breakthrough – Smart Irrigation Company & Pest Management Solution of the Year
  • Thrive Top 50
  • Google for Startups Accelerator Cohort
  • Global Cleantech Top 100

We know our journey is only achievable by having a great team who shares ideas, tries new things, and learns as we go.

Who you are:

As the ideal Customer Success Specialist, you are passionate about the customer experience, and you are familiar with, have experience with, or genuinely care about farmers. You have the ability to understand and explain our tools and insights and adjust your communication style to fit your audience.  Motivated by meaningful work, you are looking for more than just a job; you want to work for a dynamic, growing company that finds solutions to real-life problems.  Your ideal work environment includes a collaborative team spirit with the opportunity to learn and grow as you take the initiative to try new things.

You’re driven by purpose and motivated by work that matters. You’re looking for more than a role, you want to be part of a growing, forward-thinking company solving real-world challenges to improve how farming works, today and for the future. 

What you will do:

The primary function of the Customer Success Specialist is to provide exceptional support to both our customers and Semios’ Territory Managers alike. You will use your understanding of the challenges faced by our customers to help them apply Semios’ technology to solve them. You will deliver excellent support and advice to customers in their use of Semios’ tools and systems and will focus your energy on building mutually beneficial relationships to create value for both Semios and our customers.  The role will be most effective by collaborating with stakeholders throughout the Semios + Agworld's sales, marketing and field services organization. 

This role will execute and deliver on company initiatives for customer success, while enabling our sales organization to focus on growing the business. This role will work with the Customer Success Supervisor and Director of Operations Support to achieve championed customer engagement and support to our sales and field services teams to allow for focus on driving growth and providing exceptional service to our markets.

Pre- & Post-sales Functions

  • Conduct pre-sale activities including creation of customer accounts, quotes and sales orders.
  • Obtaining proper approvals for customer discounts and rates. 
  • Initiate, coordinate, and execute customer contract renewals, both remotely and in person.
  • Update and maintain internal systems (CRM, etc.) for your assigned territory.
  • Ensure all customer communications are accurately logged within the CRM for your assigned territory.  
  • Work closely with local Territory Managers to ensure all preparation activities for renewals or upcoming customer meetings are completed. Create and execute on service tickets for your assigned customers in a timely manner.

Customer Engagement

  • Conduct onboardings with customers and their teams both virtually and in person. 
  • Provide continuous support to customers in your territory both virtually and in person, being the first line of support via phone, email, and in-app chat.
  • Attend and act as a company representative at various trade shows and events, showcasing Semios’ products and services to customers and prospects alike.
  • Provide support to Territory Manager with regards to customer requests they are receiving, including providing information about planned, ongoing, or completed services.
  • Document and relay product feedback and customer suggestions to the Semios team via appropriate channels.
  • Ensure customer engagement with Semios’ suite of tools via regular outreach to ensure they are getting the most out of our products.
  • Ensure our customers are aware of and educated on the power of Semios’ tools.

Internal Support Functions

  • Support various company initiatives.
  • Work closely with Sales Operations to ensure sales data in systems is complete and accurate
  • Collaborate with Finance, Grower Relations, and Channel teams to support sales growth and strategic initiatives.
  • Work as a team with the Territory Manager in your region, enabling them to focus on selling
  • Contribute to the creation and updating of customer resource material.
  • Represent the customer’s voice and help champion best practices of customer on-boarding, adoption and product use experience.
  • Document and relay product feedback and customer suggestions back to the Semios team.
  • Suggest and implement ways to improve all processes in the customer journey.

Requirements

We want you to succeed, so you will need:

  • 2 + years of  professional experience working with customer on-boarding, implementation, adoption, and technical support
  • Highly tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and tools
  • Familiarity working with software applications and data
  • A magnetic personality and a skill for winning customer time and trust
  • Superb listening and presentation skills to build and maintain customer relationships
  • Ability to prioritize and focus efficiently on multiple customers and products
  • Orientation towards taking initiative and continuous improvement
  • Valid driver's license and ability to commute when necessary

Nice to have: 

  • Degree or diploma in business or a related field is preferred
  • Direct experience working in Agriculture.
  • Fluency in Spanish

Salary range: $27 to $31 USD per hour

We publish a salary range to provide transparency and represent the full growth potential of the role; as a result, offers are made based on demonstrated mastery and experience and generally fall near the midpoint.

Benefits

Why this is the opportunity for you:

  • Purposeful Work: Make a global impact by advancing sustainable food production.
  • Our People: Work with a fun, collaborative, and supportive team.
  • Recharge: Generous vacation policy and year-end winter break.
  • Work Flexibility: Enjoy a hybrid office setting or fully remote. (role dependent)
  • Wellbeing: Comprehensive health plans and enroll in our 401(K) plan.

At Semios Group, we value the full range of experience and perspectives people bring—not just what’s listed in a job description. If your background is a close match, we encourage you to apply. If you need accommodations during the interview process, please let us know. 

We welcome all applicants regardless of race, gender, orientation, sexual identity, economic class, ability, disability, age, religious beliefs or disbeliefs, or status. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. 

Semios Group participates in E-Verify.
